dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge spline following a deep inward curve from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a significant irregular notch at the highest pixel coordinate.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 45-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.8 times the vertical height from the dorsal midline to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notch at the dorsal fin apex; multiple linear depigmented rake marks on the lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, diffused pigmentation zone concentrated at the anterior base of the dorsal fin.
